description: Expectation of a direct SPEI transfer between loan parties (non-custodial model, RFC-002/003, docs/p2p-direct-payments-architecture.md v1.2 D14). Every funding or repayment declaration is born from an intent that records expected amount, beneficiary snapshot and suggested reference. FUNDING intents expire 5 days after contract signature (D12) sending the loan back to the marketplace. SmartLoans NEVER moves the money — intents only describe what the payer must transfer bank-to-bank.

fields.name: installmentId
fields.description: Target installment. NULL for FUNDING and free PARTIAL/PAYOFF intents.

fields.name: intentType
fields.description: Allowed values: FUNDING, INSTALLMENT, PARTIAL, PAYOFF. Lookup values live in database hints, not a separate table.

fields.name: expectedAmountMXN
fields.description: Exact amount the payer must transfer. Positive, decimal(18,2).

fields.name: payerClientId
fields.description: Who must send the SPEI (lender on FUNDING, borrower on repayments).

fields.name: payeeClientId
fields.description: Who receives the SPEI in their own bank account.

fields.name: beneficiarySnapshotId
fields.description: bankAccountSnapshots row frozen at contract time (D19) — beneficiary bank, CLABE and expected holder name come from here, never from the live profile.

fields.name: suggestedReference
fields.description: Transfer reference the payer should use, format SL-{loanNumber}-{n}.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: FUNDING only: contract signature + 5 days (D12). Cron expires OPEN intents past this moment.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Allowed values: OPEN, DECLARED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED. Transitions only via SP action; defaults to OPEN.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
A loan has one FUNDING intent and many repayment intents.

components.name: PaymentIntentListStep
components.description: IonList newest-first filtered by companyId + loanId: intentType chip, expectedAmountMXN, payer→payee, status chip (OPEN blue / DECLARED green / EXPIRED gray / CANCELLED red), expiresAt countdown for FUNDING.

hints: Status machine: OPEN -> DECLARED | EXPIRED | CANCELLED. Any other transition must return an error.
Extra action 'expire_due': marks OPEN intents with expiresAt <= GETUTCDATE() as EXPIRED and returns the affected loanIds so the caller can transition loans to 'expired'.
Only ONE intent with intentType='FUNDING' per loanId (unique filtered index).
Index (status, expiresAt) for the expiry cron sweep.
intentType and status allowed values are CHECK constraints, not lookup tables.
